articles.title: Kraken parent Payward delays IPO to second quarter of 2027 at earliest
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange operator, which confidentially filed for a U.S. listing last November, had already put its IPO plans on hold amid difficult market conditions.

articles.title: BitMEX co-founder contributed 75% of Reform UK’s donations in Q2 2026
articles.snippet: The UK political party and its leader, Nigel Farage, have accepted contributions from figures tied to the crypto industry, raising questions about potential influence on policies.

articles.title: BTC will hit $1M by 2030... but Arthur Hayes is buying ETH instead
